verdict.rationale: The Division runs online filing portals, so opting out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for this kind of service. The evidence pack says nothing about telemetry, cookies, analytics or any tracking opt-out. The opt-in text and email notification sign-ups are a related but different feature and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
